name: Create a hunt and resolve the first attack
description: Verifies the critical solo play loop creates a session and commits one deterministic combat turn.
steps: Enter adventurer name Rook and create a hunt
Confirm a six-character session code and Turn 1 are visible
expected: The game advances to Turn 2, the Warden combat result is visible in the Shared Chronicle, and Dungeon Master narration is visible.

name: Second adventurer joins and receives realtime turn updates
description: Verifies two browsers share one hunt and accepted turns propagate without refreshing.
setup: Actor A creates a hunt as Rook and keeps the six-character session code
steps: Actor B opens the app, selects Join Hunt, enters name Ash and Actor A's session code
Actor A performs the currently legal action
Actor B keeps the session open without refreshing
expected: Actor B sees the updated turn number and new Shared Chronicle entry automatically.

name: Awaken the sealed crow altar
description: Verifies the slice supports a story interaction that changes canonical world state without being combat.
steps: Choose Altar while it is sealed
Observe the crypt board and Shared Chronicle
expected: The altar changes from SEALED to AWAKE, the turn advances, and the interaction is recorded with Dungeon Master narration.

name: Reject an out-of-turn action without mutating shared state
description: Verifies a non-active player cannot advance or alter the encounter.
setup: Actor A creates a hunt as Rook
Actor B joins the same hunt as Ash while Rook remains the active actor
steps: Actor B attempts to choose Attack
Compare the displayed turn number before and after the attempt
expected: Actor B cannot commit the attack, a visible not-your-turn state is shown, and the turn number does not advance.

name: Submit a role-play action on mobile
description: Verifies the mobile layout keeps the encounter and action controls usable for a role-play turn.
steps: Enter I ask the Warden who sealed this crypt in the spoken action field
expected: The turn is accepted, the spoken line appears in the shared result/narration, and no horizontal scrolling is required to use the action controls.
